title: Cord Manager
description: A client-side utility mod that allows you to photograph, save, and manage important coordinates with a single hotkey.
body:
**CordManager** is a _lightweight_, client-side utility mod designed to make tracking important locations in Minecraft incredibly fluid. Never again will you need to alt-tab to a notepad or clutter your chat with coordinates you'll inevitably lose.

Features:

**📸 Smart Capture:** Simply take a screenshot while the F3 debug menu is open! The mod will automatically intercept the event and prompt you to give your current location a name.

**💾 Comprehensive Data Logging:** CordManager seamlessly captures your exact X, Y, and Z coordinates along with the dimension you are currently in.

**📖 In-Game Logbook**: Access all your saved waypoints directly from a new, convenient button added to the game's Pause Menu.

**👀 Visual Previews:** The coordinate manager GUI features built-in pagination and allows you to view the exact screenshot you took at the moment the coordinate was saved, making it visually easy to remember why you saved a location.

**⚙️ JSON Configuration:** All your coordinates are securely saved locally in a structured JSON file, making it easy to back up, edit, or share your locations outside the game.

Perfect for explorers, builders, and absent-minded adventurers who want an immersive, built-in way to manage their worlds!
